_readme: Demo-vault overlay of the template's config.json. The template ships
unonboarded (timezone and executive null) because a fresh vault must not
claim an owner it does not have. The demo vault is different: its context
portfolio already names Morgan Ellery as the executive, so leaving the
machine config null made every pipeline skill halt at its config gate on a
vault that otherwise looks fully populated.
